name: shot-capture
summary: Render a camera view of a scene to a PNG in batch mode, only once the scene is ready, so an agent can look at what it built and trust the picture.
adapt: Let Unity create the .meta files on the next open or compile, then commit them with the script.
Add Shots/ to .gitignore unless you want captures in the repository.
Needs unity-driver 0.2.0 or newer: the capture finishes on editor updates, so the driver must start it without -quit.
verify: node Tools/gam3/unity_run.mjs exec Gam3.Shot.Capture --profile agent -- -gam3Scene <Assets/path/To.unity> -gam3Out Shots/check.png

verified.how: Rendered the terrain-from-data scene in batch mode under --profile agent (640x360, lowest quality) and --profile human (1600x900), several times each: GAM3READY: ok frames=3, ready=ok, and the images were opened and checked. Forced a timeout with -gam3ReadyTimeout 0.001: GAM3READY: TIMEOUT waiting=unsettled, the picture was written as UNREADY and the run was FAILED with exit 1. With -nographics the capture failed with a clear message. An earlier version that waited inside one synchronous call never saw shader compilation finish (60 s timeout, waiting=shaders), which is why the wait now runs on editor updates. Not run: a scene whose shaders or assets were really still compiling or importing during the wait, URP, HDRP, Windows, Linux.
